mutants.name: M1: the baseline assignment moved back before the save call
expectRed: a rejected save keeps the baseline
a thrown save keeps the baseline

mutants.name: M2: the baseline never advanced
expectRed: a save that resolves advances the baseline
a save that returns nothing advances the baseline at once

mutants.name: M3: the later-started check removed, so an older save that settles late moves the baseline
